text:
I'm sorry your plant arrived late, that's frustrating. The policy information I have doesn't include compensation for late deliveries, so I can't promise a refund or credit. I can escalate this to a Support Lead who can review your case.

The delay may have a known cause. Live plants ship only Monday to Wednesday, and orders placed after noon Wednesday ship the next Monday. Weather holds can also delay plants by up to 7 days, and we email you when that happens.

If you send me your order number (LF- plus six digits), I'll pass it along. Please also tell me if the plant arrived damaged or in poor condition.
